'''Star Tours Flight 928''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was stationed at the spaceport's Gate 1G, and its status was on time with an estimated time of arrival at 1640 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1735.
